sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Identify the correct article to fill in the blank: We heard ___ tinkling sound coming from the valley.
Who is famous for inventing a reading and writing system for visually impaired people?
Which of the following shows the correct noun possession for 'the toys belonging to the children'?
According to the chapter 'Be Smart Be Safe', what is the most important rule before crossing a busy road?
options: A) Run as fast as you can
B) Look left, right, and left again
C) Close your eyes and walk
questions.answer: B) Look left, right, and left again

questions.question_text: Identify the complete subject in the following sentence: 'The brave little boy saved the puppy.'
What does the poem 'One Thing at a Time' advise us to do?
options: A) Do many tasks together quickly
B) Focus on doing one task properly
questions.answer: B) Focus on doing one task properly

questions.question_text: Choose the correct pronoun: 'My sister and I are going to the market. ___ will buy fresh fruits.'
In the story 'The Old Stag', what was the stag most proud of?
options: A) His swift and thin legs

questions.question_text: Choose the correct verb to complete the sentence: 'A herd of cows ___ grazing in the green field.'
Identify the helping verb in the sentence: 'She was reading a book in the library.'

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Why is teamwork highlighted as important in the chapter 'Together We Can'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Teamwork is important because working together makes difficult tasks much easier. It helps friends combine their unique strengths to solve problems quickly and successfully.

questions.question_text: Pick out the proper noun and the abstract noun from the sentence: 'Ravi showed great courage during the fire.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: In this sentence, the proper noun is 'Ravi' because it is a specific person's name. The abstract noun is 'courage' because it is a feeling or quality.

questions.question_text: What made the tinkling bells sound so special to the listeners? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The tinkling bells sounded special because they produced a sweet, magical melody that brought a sense of peace and joy to all the tired villagers.

questions.question_text: Change the following statement into an interrogative sentence: 'The children are playing safely in the park.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To change this statement into a question, we move the helping verb to the beginning of the sentence: 'Are the children playing safely in the park?'

questions.question_text: How does the Braille system help visually impaired people to read? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The Braille system uses unique patterns of raised dots on thick paper. Visually impaired people can read by running their fingertips over these dots to feel letters.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are teaching your younger brother about safety at home. What three important rules would you tell him to follow? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would tell him to never touch electrical switches with wet hands, avoid playing with sharp objects like knives or scissors, and always keep his toys packed away so no one trips over them. Staying alert prevents bad accidents at home.

questions.question_text: Read the following short paragraph and rewrite it correcting the pronoun and subject-verb agreement errors: 'The dogs is barking loudly. Him want to go outside. My sister open the door for they.' [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The corrected paragraph is: 'The dogs are barking loudly. They want to go outside. My sister opens the door for them.' The verbs and pronouns now correctly match the plural subject 'dogs', and the main verb correctly matches the singular subject 'sister'.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Formal Writing

questions.question_text: Imagine you are the Old Stag looking at your reflection. Describe how your feelings change from pride to sadness, and what important lesson you realize in the end. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Looking in the clear water, I felt immense pride seeing my grand, beautiful antlers. But my joy faded when I saw my thin, ugly legs. Later, when hunters chased me, my proud antlers got stuck in branches, but my ugly legs helped me escape. I realized that looks can be deceiving.

questions.question_text: Write a short formal application to your class teacher asking to be excused from the sports period today because you have a sprained ankle. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Teacher, I am writing to inform you that I twisted my foot yesterday and currently have a sprained ankle. The doctor has strictly advised me not to run or jump. Therefore, I request you to kindly excuse me from attending the sports period today. Thanking you, Yours obediently.
